sbar.situation: The bank system has recovered and recovery is confirmed. Two recovery checks ran, and the last, at 35 s, was clean (2 of 2 in a row).
sbar.background: Traffic dropped earlier and then recovered on its own. Operators deployed screening-standby 4.1.2 and restarted it while it carried no traffic.
sbar.assessment: No fault was found and the incident commander took no corrective action. All components are at baseline with no errors, normal p95, a draining clearing queue, clean ledger integrity and no held locks. The payment probe passed end to end.
sbar.recommendation: Watch screening-standby 4.1.2 closely if a failover happens, because it is untested under traffic, although its logs are clean. Nothing was escalated, and the facts show no money or data effects for the operations team to review.
